content.title: The Sunnah of His ﷺ Final Moments
content.subtitle: Is it still part of our lives today?
content.body:
Think of that moment! The journey of this world was nearing its end. Our beloved Prophet ﷺ was resting with his head in the lap of his beloved wife, Aisha (RA). His body was extremely weak.

Abdur Rahman (RA) entered with a miswak. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ looked at it. Aisha (RA) understood his wish and softened the miswak with her teeth.

In the final moments of his life, even as his breath grew faint, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used the miswak. Then he uttered, “Fi Rafiqil A‘la” (In the company of the Highest Companion). And then… he departed to his Lord. (Sahih Bukhari: 4438)

A Remarkable Sign of Love and Emphasis

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “Had it not been difficult for my Ummah, I would have commanded them to use the miswak at every prayer.”

(Sahih Bukhari: 887)

He placed great emphasis on this Sunnah. Will it disappear from our lives?

The Blessings and Virtues of Miswak

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “Miswak is purification for the mouth and a means of pleasing the Lord.”

(Sunan an-Nasa’i: 5)

Some books mention more than 70 benefits of regular miswak use. Some pious scholars have expressed hope that this habit may, by Allah’s mercy, lead to being blessed with the Kalimah Shahadah at death.

Is Love Only in Words, or Also in Deeds?

We say that we love the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Yet the Sunnah that accompanied him in his final moments-can it not find a place in our lives?

Let a Forgotten Sunnah Come Alive

Pick up a miswak today. Bring this Sunnah back into your life. Perhaps, seeing you, another family member will begin, and then another.

A small miswak could begin the return of a forgotten Sunnah.
